may_disappear.reason: The bootstrap's last command is `git commit -am "new commit"`, so the colocated Git HEAD is ahead of jj and `@` is the empty undescribed commit on top of `initial commit`. The task IS `jj git import`, which resets the working-copy parent to the new Git HEAD -- that moves `@` off this commit to somewhere that is not its descendant, and jj auto-abandons an empty undescribed commit it moves off, so this change id necessarily stops resolving. Nothing graded refers to it: both scored tests are about the imported Git commit being visible and being an ancestor of the NEW `@`.
